info.description: The Meeting Status Reporting API provides access to the current status of meetings within the system. Users can retrieve real-time information on various meetings, allowing them to monitor progress and participation. This endpoint is particularly useful for event coordinators and managers who need to track meeting efficiency and attendance. By integrating this API, developers can create applications that offer insights and analytics on meeting performance.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of meetings
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of meetings within the system. It can be used to check if meetings are scheduled, ongoing, or completed, providing insights into the meeting management workflow.
